tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary fill: primary buttons, the selected choice tile and segment, the current step, staff table heads, the active staff tab, the staff sidebar. Label it with `on-brand` (7.48:1 resident, 14.68:1 staff). Landlord portal: deep violet #4B3A8F (9.13:1 with `on-brand`).

tokens.name: brand-band-top
tokens.usage: Top stop of the brand band gradient: resident header band, start panel, sign-in ground, modal head; staff sign-in ground only.

tokens.name: brand-band-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom stop of the brand band gradient; pairs with `brand-band-top`.

tokens.name: brand-raised
tokens.usage: A control resting on the brand band or the staff sidebar: resident nav pills, the staff active nav row, the staff user card, the raised count on the active staff tab. `on-brand` reads 7.50:1 / 11.4:1.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-raised`, `accent`, `panel-head` and the brand band.

tokens.name: on-brand-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the brand band: the resident EN/ES off state (2.97:1 on the band, fails - AA theme #C0D1D4) and staff sidebar group labels (6.22:1 on `brand`).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The action colour. Resident screens act in `brand`; staff screens act in royal blue: New case, Fill the gaps, Sign in, in-table links, the Pre-submit QA and E-sign Approval tab links. `on-brand` 9.10:1.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px solid with a 2px offset. Added by the system (the Figma draws no focus state): 7.06:1 on `surface-page` resident, 8.54:1 staff.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page ground under cards. Resident is warm cream, staff is cool grey.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the staff record header, the staff top bar search field, modals.

tokens.name: surface-field
tokens.usage: Fill of text fields, choice tiles, segmented controls and member rows (resident); filter selects, tab bars and grey buttons (staff).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: The active row of a side list: application nav, admin configuration nav.

tokens.name: surface-drop

tokens.name: table-row

tokens.name: table-row-alt
tokens.usage: Even staff table rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Dividers and card outlines. Decorative only: never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-field
tokens.usage: 1px edge of fields and choice tiles. 1.18:1 on white fails WCAG 1.4.11; the AA themes use #9E9381 / #9191AD.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Dotted edge of a drop zone and the edge of outline buttons.

tokens.name: control-ring
tokens.usage: The unselected radio dot in a choice tile and the off check circle. 1.33:1 fails; AA themes use #909090.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text and glyph icons on light grounds. The Figma sets text in pure black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Supporting copy: sub-lines under headings, ledes, the estimate pill, stat tile captions. 6.20:1 on `surface-page` resident, 4.67:1 staff.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Not-yet-done checklist items and secondary table cells. 3.36:1 / 3.23:1 fails at these sizes; AA themes use #767676 / #656668.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: The helper line under a sidebar heading. 2.38:1 fails; AA themes use #767676.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in fields. 2.34:1 on `surface-field` fails; AA themes use #757271 / #767676. Never put instructions only in a placeholder.

tokens.name: eyebrow
tokens.usage: The warm label above a resident side list ("Your application"). 3.49:1 on white fails at 16px; AA themes use #877457.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Resident links are underlined ink; staff links are `accent`.

tokens.name: success
